# netcup_dns_records (Data Source)

Reads all DNS records for a netcup DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_dns_records" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
}

output "records" {
  value = data.netcup_dns_records.example.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain name of the DNS zone.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) List of DNS records in the zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `ttl` (Number) TTL for all records in the zone.

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) Record destination.
- `hostname` (String) Record hostname.
- `id` (String) Record ID.
- `priority` (Number) Record priority.
- `type` (String) Record type.
